lore.shortDescription: You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls you make with ranged weapons.
While you are wearing armor, you gain a +1 bonus to AC.
When you are wielding a melee weapon in one hand and no other weapons, you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls with that weapon.

When you roll a 1 or 2 on a damage die for an attack you make with a melee weapon that you are wielding with two hands, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll, even if the new roll is a 1 or a 2. The weapon must have the two-handed or versatile property for you to…
lore.fullText: When you roll a 1 or 2 on a damage die for an attack you make with a melee weapon that you are wielding with two hands, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll, even if the new roll is a 1 or a 2. The weapon must have the two-handed or versatile property for you to gain this benefit.

lore.shortDescription: When a creature you can see attacks a target other than you that is within 5 feet of you, you can use your reaction to impose disadvantage on the attack roll. You must be wielding a shield.

implementation.summary: Phase 1 keeps Protection as a sheet-level reaction helper for tabletop play rather than forcing a target-aware enemy model into the engine.

lore.shortDescription: When you engage in two-weapon fighting, you can add your ability modifier to the damage of the second attack.
Spend 1 sorcery point to shield chosen creatures from your spell's effect on a successful save.
Spend 1 sorcery point to double a spell's range, or to give a touch spell 30 feet of range.
Spend 1 sorcery point to reroll damage dice up to your Charisma modifier.
Spend 1 sorcery point to double a spell's duration, up to 24 hours.
Spend 3 sorcery points to give one target disadvantage on its first save against the spell.
Spend 2 sorcery points to cast a 1-action spell as a bonus action.
Spend 1 sorcery point to cast without verbal or somatic components.
Spend sorcery points equal to the spell's level to target a second creature.
You learn find familiar and can take special forms; your familiar can attack with your bonus action.
You can conjure a pact weapon you are proficient with and which counts as magical.
You gain a Book of Shadows holding three cantrips from any class's spell list.
Add your Charisma modifier to eldritch blast damage.
Cast mage armor on yourself at will, without a slot.
Cast levitate on yourself at will, without a slot.
Cast speak with animals at will.
Gain proficiency in Deception and Persuasion.
Cast compulsion once per long rest using a warlock slot.
Inscribe and cast ritual spells from your Book of Shadows.
Cast hold monster at will on a celestial, fiend, or elemental.
See normally in darkness, magical or not, out to 120 feet.
Cast confusion once per long rest using a warlock slot.
Cast detect magic at will.
Eldritch blast gains 300 feet of range.
You can read all writing.
Cast false life on yourself at will as a 1st-level spell.
Perceive through a willing humanoid's senses until the end of your next turn.
Your pact weapon deals extra necrotic damage equal to your Charisma modifier.
Cast disguise self at will.
Cast alter self at will.
Cast conjure elemental once per long rest using a warlock slot.
Cast slow once per long rest using a warlock slot.
Cast silent image at will.
Become invisible while in dim light or darkness until you move or act.
Cast jump on yourself at will.
Push a creature 10 feet away when eldritch blast hits it.
Cast polymorph once per long rest using a warlock slot.
Cast bestow curse once per long rest using a warlock slot.
Cast bane once per long rest using a warlock slot.
Attack twice with your pact weapon when you take the Attack action.
Cast arcane eye at will.
Communicate telepathically with your familiar and perceive through its senses.
Cast speak with dead at will.
See the true form of shapechangers and creatures concealed by illusion within 30 feet.
While raging you have resistance to all damage except psychic.
While raging and unarmored, opportunity attacks against you have disadvantage and you can Dash as a bonus action.
While raging, your allies have advantage on melee attacks against enemies within 5 feet of you.
Your carrying capacity doubles and you have advantage on Strength checks to move objects.
You can see up to a mile away with ease and dim light does not impose disadvantage on Perception.
You can track at a fast pace and move stealthily at a normal pace.
While raging, enemies within 5 feet have disadvantage attacking anyone but you.
While raging, you gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed for one turn.
While raging, you can knock a Large or smaller creature prone when you hit it.
Spend an action to briefly manipulate a Tiny elemental effect within 30 feet.
Spend 1 ki to extend your unarmed reach by 10 feet and deal fire damage.
Spend 2 ki to cast thunderwave.
Spend 2 ki to push and damage a creature within 30 feet.
Spend 2 ki to cast gust of wind.
Spend 1 ki to freeze, thaw, or reshape water within 120 feet.
Spend 2 ki to cast burning hands.
Spend 2 ki to pull, knock prone, and damage a creature within 30 feet.
Spend 3 ki to cast hold person.
Spend 3 ki to cast shatter.
Spend 4 ki to cast fireball.
Spend 4 ki to cast gaseous form on yourself.
Spend 4 ki to cast fly on yourself.
Spend 6 ki to cast cone of cold.
Spend 5 ki to cast stoneskin on yourself.
Spend 5 ki to cast wall of fire.
Spend 6 ki to cast wall of stone.
Deal an extra 1d8 damage once per turn to a creature below its hit point maximum.
React to attack a Large or larger creature that hits or misses you within 5 feet.
Once per turn, attack a second creature adjacent to your first target.
Opportunity attacks against you are made with disadvantage.
After a creature hits you, it takes -4 on its further attacks against you that turn.
You have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.
Make a ranged attack against any number of creatures within 10 feet of a point.
Make a melee attack against any number of creatures within 5 feet of you.
Take no damage on a successful Dexterity save, and half on a failure.
Redirect a missed melee attack against another creature of your choice.
React to halve the damage of an attack you can see.
Forgo an attack to let an ally strike, adding a superiority die to the damage.
Force a target to drop an item on a failed Strength save.
Give the next attacker advantage against your target.
Add a superiority die to AC while you move.
Gain advantage against a creature within 5 feet, plus bonus damage.
The target has disadvantage attacking anyone but you on a failed Wisdom save.
Extend your melee reach by 5 feet for one attack.
Let an ally move half their speed without provoking from your target.
Frighten the target until the end of your next turn on a failed Wisdom save.
React to reduce melee damage by a superiority die plus your Dexterity modifier.
Add a superiority die to an attack roll.
Push a Large or smaller target 15 feet on a failed Strength save.
Grant an ally temporary hit points equal to a superiority die plus your Charisma modifier.
React to attack a creature that misses you with a melee attack.
Deal superiority die damage to a second creature within 5 feet of your target.
Knock a Large or smaller target prone on a failed Strength save.
Proficiency in Dexterity and Charisma saving throws.
Proficiency in Wisdom and Charisma saving throws.
Proficiency in Intelligence and Wisdom saving throws.
Proficiency in Strength and Constitution saving throws.
Proficiency in Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
Proficiency in Wisdom and Charisma saving throws.
Proficiency in Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
Proficiency in Dexterity and Intelligence saving throws.
Proficiency in Constitution and Charisma saving throws.
Proficiency in Wisdom and Charisma saving throws.
Proficiency in Intelligence and Wisdom saving throws.
You and friendly creatures within 10 feet add your Charisma modifier to saving throws, as long as you are not incapacitated.
